structured.answer: If I have to choose, I'd take the first one, "א. קבוצה לכל סוג השקעה". Each kind of investment comes under its own heading, so at least I know what I'm looking at. But I didn't find anything safe there for my money. I'll ask you, and maybe the bank, before I move a single shekel.

stuck.where: Screen 2, top of the list in option א
stuck.why: The first group is 'עוקב מדד s&p 500', English letters and shares. I nearly closed the page there and then. I wanted אג"ח ממשלתי, which I saw as a button at the top, but its group never showed up on the screens I read.
Every row has two percentages, a number like 13874, and a little coloured circle. I didn't know which number matters to me.
Everything is mixed in one list: shares next to אשראי ואג"ח. I couldn't tell which is which without reading the small label under every name.

findings.what: The page is black with grey writing. Even enlarged it's hard to read, and the explanation lines are small and grey.
findings.where: Whole page, especially the paragraphs under the headings and the 'חשיפה' column

findings.what: It opens with English letters and shares (S&P 500). For someone who wants something safe, that's a reason to leave.
findings.where: Screen 2, first group in option א

findings.what: Too many numbers in every row: two management-fee percentages, a fund number, two exposure percentages and a circle. It makes me anxious.
Nothing says in words which track is safe and which is risky.
findings.where: The group headings and the rows

findings.what: The group closest to what I want (government bonds) is at the bottom of option א. I didn't get that far.
findings.where: Option א, the order of the groups

findings.what: In option ב everything is mixed in one list. You have to read a small label under every row.
The yellow and turquoise in the little dots look alike to me.
The note at the end of option א is in small orange text that's hard to read.
